entries.source: fn v_source(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r2 = max(dot(p, p), 0.01); return p / r2 * mix(0.3, 1.5, k.x) * select(1.0, -1.0, k.y > 0.5); }
entries.vortex: fn v_vortex(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r2 = max(dot(p, p), 0.01); return vec2f(-p.y, p.x) / r2 * mix(0.3, 1.5, k.x); }
entries.rankine: fn v_rankine(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r = length(p); let a = mix(0.15, 0.6, k.x); let w = select(1.0 / max(r, 1e-3), r / (a * a), r < a); return vec2f(-p.y, p.x) / max(r, 1e-3) * w * a * mix(0.5, 2.0, k.y); }
entries.doublet: fn v_doublet(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r2 = max(dot(p, p), 0.005); let r4 = r2 * r2; return vec2f((p.y * p.y - p.x * p.x), -2.0 * p.x * p.y) / r4 * 0.05 * mix(0.3, 2.0, k.x); }
entries.spiral_sink: fn v_spiral_sink(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r2 = max(dot(p, p), 0.01); return (vec2f(-p.y, p.x) * mix(0.0, 1.5, k.x) - p * mix(0.1, 1.0, k.y)) / sqrt(r2); }
entries.taylor_green: fn v_taylor_green(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let f = mix(2.0, 8.0, k.x) * PI; let q = p * 0.5 + 0.5; return vec2f(sin(f * q.x) * cos(f * q.y), -cos(f * q.x) * sin(f * q.y)) * exp(-0.0 * t); }
entries.shear: fn v_shear(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let w = mix(0.05, 0.3, k.y); return vec2f(tanh(p.y / w) * mix(0.5, 1.5, k.x) + 0.1 * sin(p.x * 10.0 + t), 0.05 * sin(p.x * 6.0 - t * 0.7) * k.z); }
entries.pendulum: fn v_pendulum(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let th = p.x * PI * 2.0; let w = p.y * 4.0; return vec2f(w / (PI * 2.0), (-sin(th) * mix(2.0, 8.0, k.x) - mix(0.0, 1.5, k.y) * w) / 4.0) * 0.5; }
entries.vanderpol: fn v_vanderpol(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let x = p.x * 3.0; let y = p.y * 3.0; let mu = mix(0.2, 2.5, k.x); return vec2f(y, mu * (1.0 - x * x) * y - x) / 3.0 * 0.4; }
entries.duffing: fn v_duffing(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let x = p.x * 2.0; let y = p.y * 2.0; let d = mix(0.0, 0.6, k.y); return vec2f(y, x - x * x * x - d * y + mix(0.0, 0.8, k.x) * cos(t * 1.2)) * 0.4; }
entries.lotka: fn v_lotka(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let x = (p.x + 1.0) * 2.0; let y = (p.y + 1.0) * 2.0; let a = mix(0.8, 1.6, k.x); return vec2f(a * x - x * y, x * y - a * y) * 0.25; }
entries.hopf: fn v_hopf(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r2 = dot(p, p); let mu = mix(-0.3, 0.6, k.x); return (p * (mu - r2) + vec2f(-p.y, p.x) * mix(0.5, 2.0, k.y)) * 0.7; }
entries.saddle: fn v_saddle(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let a = k.x * PI; return rot2(a) * (vec2f(1.0, -1.0) * (rot2(-a) * p)) * mix(0.5, 1.5, k.y); }
entries.lorenz:
// a projection of the Lorenz flow onto (x, z), y reconstructed from a knob — chaos as a field
fn v_lorenz(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let x = p.x * 25.0; let z = p.y * 25.0 + 25.0; let y = x * mix(0.6, 1.4, k.x); let s = 10.0; let r = 28.0; let b = 8.0 / 3.0; return vec2f(s * (y - x), x * y - b * z) / 25.0 * 0.03; }
entries.gradient: fn v_gradient(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { return grad_fbm(p * mix(1.0, 4.0, k.x), t * 0.1 * k.y, 37u) * 0.3 * select(1.0, -1.0, k.z > 0.5); }
entries.curl_plus_stream: fn v_curl_plus_stream(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let g = grad_fbm(p * mix(1.0, 4.0, k.x), t * 0.1, 41u); return vec2f(g.y, -g.x) * mix(0.0, 0.6, k.y) + vec2f(mix(0.2, 1.0, k.z), 0.0); }
entries.wind: fn v_wind(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let g1 = grad_fbm(p * 1.5, t * 0.15, 43u); let g2 = grad_fbm(p * 5.0 + 3.0, t * 0.4, 47u); return vec2f(g1.y, -g1.x) * 0.5 + vec2f(g2.y, -g2.x) * 0.12 * mix(0.0, 2.0, k.x) + vec2f(0.3 + 0.2 * sin(t * 0.5), 0.0) * k.y; }
entries.stagnation:
// —— more potential flow ————————————————————————————————————————————————————
fn v_stagnation(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { return rot2(k.y * PI) * (vec2f(p.x, -p.y) * mix(0.4, 1.5, k.x)); }
entries.source_vortex: fn v_source_vortex(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r = max(length(p), 0.05); return (p * mix(0.2, 1.0, k.x) + vec2f(-p.y, p.x) * mix(0.3, 1.5, k.y)) / r; }
entries.rankine_halfbody: fn v_rankine_halfbody(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r2 = max(dot(p, p), 0.01); return vec2f(mix(0.3, 1.0, k.y), 0.0) + p / r2 * mix(0.2, 0.8, k.x); }
entries.channel: fn v_channel(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { return vec2f((1.0 - p.y * p.y) * mix(0.5, 1.6, k.x), 0.0); }
entries.couette: fn v_couette(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { return vec2f(p.y * mix(0.5, 1.6, k.x) + mix(0.0, 0.5, k.y), 0.0); }
entries.stokeslet: fn v_stokeslet(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let f = rot2(k.y * TAU) * vec2f(1.0, 0.0); let r = max(length(p), 0.06); let rh = p / r; return (f * (-log(r)) + rh * dot(f, rh)) * mix(0.1, 0.4, k.x); }
entries.jet: fn v_jet(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let env = exp(-p.y * p.y * mix(3.0, 12.0, k.z)); return vec2f(mix(0.4, 1.4, k.x) * env, cos(p.x * mix(2.0, 6.0, k.y) * PI + t * 0.6) * 0.4 * env); }
entries.double_vortex: fn v_double_vortex(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let pa = p - vec2f(-0.35, 0.0); let pb = p - vec2f(0.35, 0.0); let s = mix(0.3, 1.2, k.x); return s * (vec2f(-pa.y, pa.x) / max(dot(pa, pa), 0.02) + vec2f(-pb.y, pb.x) / max(dot(pb, pb), 0.02)); }
entries.source_sink: fn v_source_sink(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let pa = p - vec2f(-0.4, 0.0); let pb = p - vec2f(0.4, 0.0); return (pa / max(dot(pa, pa), 0.02) - pb / max(dot(pb, pb), 0.02)) * mix(0.1, 0.5, k.x); }
entries.charged_ring: fn v_charged_ring(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r = length(p); let R = mix(0.3, 0.6, k.x); return normalize(p + vec2f(1e-4)) * (r - R) * mix(1.0, 3.0, k.y); }
entries.two_body: fn v_two_body(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let ph = t * 0.4; let c1 = vec2f(cos(ph), sin(ph)) * 0.35; let d1 = c1 - p; let d2 = -c1 - p; let e = mix(0.02, 0.15, k.y); return (d1 / pow(dot(d1, d1) + e * e, 1.5) + d2 / pow(dot(d2, d2) + e * e, 1.5)) * 0.05 * mix(0.5, 1.5, k.x); }
entries.node: fn v_node(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let l1 = mix(-1.0, 1.0, k.x); let l2 = mix(-1.0, 1.0, k.y); return vec2f(l1 * p.x, l2 * p.y) * 0.8; }
entries.spiral:
// —— more phase portraits —————————————————————————————————————————————————————
fn v_spiral(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let a = mix(-0.6, 0.3, k.x); let w = mix(0.5, 2.0, k.y); return vec2f(a * p.x - w * p.y, w * p.x + a * p.y); }
entries.limit_cycle: fn v_limit_cycle(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r = length(p); let R = mix(0.3, 0.7, k.x); let rh = p / max(r, 1e-3); return (rh * (R - r) * mix(1.0, 3.0, k.y) + vec2f(-rh.y, rh.x) * mix(0.5, 1.5, k.z)) * 0.8; }
entries.selkov: fn v_selkov(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let x = (p.x + 1.0) * 1.5; let y = (p.y + 1.0) * 1.5; let a = mix(0.05, 0.15, k.x); let b = mix(0.4, 1.0, k.y); return vec2f(-x + a * y + x * x * y, b - a * y - x * x * y) * 0.4; }
entries.brusselator: fn v_brusselator(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let x = (p.x + 1.0) * 1.5; let y = (p.y + 1.0) * 1.5; let A = mix(0.5, 1.5, k.x); let B = mix(1.5, 3.5, k.y); return vec2f(A - (B + 1.0) * x + x * x * y, B * x - x * x * y) * 0.3; }
entries.fitzhugh_ph: fn v_fitzhugh_ph(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let vv = p.x * 2.0; let w = p.y * 2.0; let a = mix(0.5, 0.9, k.x); let eps = mix(0.05, 0.2, k.y); return vec2f(vv - vv * vv * vv / 3.0 - w, eps * (vv + a)) * 0.6; }
entries.pitchfork: fn v_pitchfork(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r = mix(-0.5, 0.5, k.x); return vec2f(r * p.x - p.x * p.x * p.x, -p.y) * mix(0.5, 1.5, k.y); }
entries.sine_flow: fn v_sine_flow(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let a = mix(1.0, 4.0, k.x); return vec2f(sin(p.y * a * PI + t * 0.5), sin(p.x * a * PI - t * 0.4)) * 0.5; }
entries.abc_slice: fn v_abc_slice(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let A = 1.0; let B = mix(0.4, 1.2, k.x); let C = mix(0.4, 1.2, k.y); let z = t * 0.2; let q = p * PI; return vec2f(A * sin(z) + C * cos(q.y), B * sin(q.x) + A * cos(z)) * 0.3; }
entries.turbulent: fn v_turbulent(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let g = grad_fbm(abs(p) * mix(1.0, 4.0, k.x), t * 0.1 * k.y, 59u); return vec2f(g.y, -g.x) * 0.4; }
